title: lithocardium peruvianum
intro: Lithocardium peruvianum, commonly known as Peruvian heart, is a plant-based remedy used to support cardiovascular health. The plant is reported to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular function, which may help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as high blood pressure and heart disease. The therapeutic actions of Lithocardium peruvianum are attributed to its ability to improve blood circulation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
